response.overview: [Issue Resolution Guide] Silversea Cruises Escalation Guide: Resolve Customer Issue? To escalate an issue with Silversea Cruises, call customer support at +1-866-259-1002 (US) and explicitly request to speak with a supervisor or tier-two escalation agent. Step-by-Step Escalation Process Initial Contact: Call +1-866-259-1002 (US) or use the official live chat/mobile app support. State your problem clearly to the frontline representative. Request a Supervisor: If the first agent cannot resolve your issue, ask immediately to be transferred to a manager, supervisor, or tier-two support team.
